text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 6932109876 - gpu-pool eu-west-1-pool-42 capacity_exhaustion detected. Queue length > 12k, service-level throttling observed. Paging on-call: @ashley_oncall. Please triage and escalate if needed.

ashley_oncall: I’m on it. Picking up the page. Any immediate customer-facing impact?

luis_support: Seeing elevated 429s reported from prod-monitoring for a handful of tenants. Top hit: tenant-acme (errors spike ~18% last 10m). Raising a support incident for customer comms.

ashley_oncall: ok, thx @luis_support. Tom, can you grab autoscaler logs and confirm whether scaleups were rejected?

tom_sre: grabbing logs now. My initial read: autoscaler attempted scaleups but got a "ScaleUpRejected: controller-concurrency-limit" repeatedly. Looks like controller hit an internal limit rather than cloud quota.

priya_infra: running quick checks on pool state and k8s:
```
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=redwood-autoscaler -o wide
kubectl -n redwood get nodes --selector=pool=eu-west-1-pool-42
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/redwood-autoscaler --since=30m | tail -n 200
```

priya_infra: logs show: "reconcile loop: scale_up_rejected: concurrent_scale_ops_limit=1 active_ops=1" repeated. Autoscaler controller appears to serialise scale operations and is not relinquishing the lock when cloud provider returns transient errors.

metrics-bot: Metric snapshot (last 15m): queue_size=12345, avg_latency=842ms, token_rate_limit=throttled, scale_attempts=12, scale_success=2, scale_rejects=8. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/pgpu/6932109876

jamie_eng: If controller is single-op lock + transient cloud error, that can cause cascading queue growth. We should open a fast path: route a subset of traffic to standby pool and bump scale operation parallelism as emergency mitigation.

ashley_oncall: Agreed. @priya_infra can you perform routing change and bump the controller parallelism flag for emergency? Include safety guard to not exceed cloud quota.

priya_infra: preparing commands. routing change (dry run first):
```
# route 30% of generation requests from pool-42 -> eu-west-1-standby
redwood route update --from pool=eu-west-1-pool-42 --to pool=eu-west-1-standby --weight 0.3 --dry-run
redwood route update --from pool=eu-west-1-pool-42 --to pool=eu-west-1-standby --weight 0.3
```

priya_infra: bumping autoscaler parallelism (temp):
```
kubectl -n infra patch deploy/redwood-autoscaler --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"4"}]'
# env var AUTOSCALER_PARALLELISM=4 (was 1)
```

deploy-bot: Triggered route update: route update id=rt-99231 status=applied.

priya_infra: routing change applied. Monitoring for error rates and queue drain. Also applied autoscaler parallelism=4. If cloud provider rate-limited scale requests, we might see more retries but controller should not block.

metrics-bot: After route and parallelism change (2m): queue_size=8210 (down ~33%), avg_latency=612ms, 429-rate reduced by 40% for tenant-acme.

luis_support: Confirmed tenant-acme real traffic improved. Sending interim note to impacted customers: "We detected a capacity issue in a subset of eu-west-1 traffic; we've applied a temporary routing and are actively remediating. We'll follow up with postmortem."

tom_sre: Root cause summary so far: autoscaler controller had a concurrency limiter bug combined with propagation of transient cloud provider errors. Controller kept the operation lock while retrying provider API calls causing subsequent scaleups to be rejected, leading to pool saturation. There was also a misleading alert threshold: we trigger scale_attempts>3 but not enough signal for scale_rejects-heavy patterns.

anaction: (note: this was a mistyped name; ignore)

ana_product: Heads-up: we should coordinate a customer-facing post-incident message template. @luis_support can you draft and share? Keep it short, acknowledge impact, mitigation, and ETA for root cause & fix.

luis_support: Will draft. ETA 60m for initial comms.

jamie_eng: I’m prepping a hotfix to autoscaler to ensure the lock is released on transient errors and to add exponential backoff + quota-aware retries. Will run a canary in staging then promote.

tom_sre: Also adding a new metric: scale_reject_reason{reason="concurrency_limit"} to alert when >1 in 5 scale attempts are rejected for that reason.

ashley_oncall: Good. For tracking: opening a short incident page and linking to this thread. We'll keep this thread as the live triage. Action items below — add owners and due dates.

--- ACTION ITEMS ---
1) jamie_eng: deploy autoscaler hotfix (unlock-on-error + backoff). Scope: hotfix to infra branch, canary in staging, prod deploy. Due: 12h.
2) tom_sre: add alert for scale_rejects_by_reason and adjust scale signal thresholds. Due: 6h.
3) priya_infra: add a safety config to allow emergency parallelism bump via operator CLI + runbook steps. Due: 24h.
4) luis_support + ana_product: draft customer comms + support playbook for tenant-level impact. Due: 1h (initial), final postmortem comms due with RCA.
5) ashley_oncall: write up incident timeline & link logs, assign postmortem owner. Due: 24h.
6) infra-eng: validate cloud provider quotas for eu-west-1 pools and add quota-exhaustion alert. Due: 48h.

ashley_oncall: Also documenting immediate mitigations taken: temporary routing to standby pool, autoscaler parallelism=4, emergency scale attempts to cloud provider. Will record timestamps in incident page.

priya_infra: Confirming we scaled up standby pool nodes by +8, and the standby pool had spare capacity. No provider quota breach observed.

metrics-bot: Final snapshot before handoff (10m after): queue_size=2100, avg_latency=310ms, scale_successes increasing, 429s near baseline.

ashley_oncall: Thanks everyone. We'll run a full RCA and postmortem doc. I'll set postmortem owner to jamie_eng and schedule a 1-hour follow-up today at 1600 UTC. If anyone else needs to be added to postmortem, ping me.

anaction (again a stray): :shrug: ignore

tom_sre: Quick note for postmortem: include a timeline of scale_attempts, cloud provider responses, and controller lock state. Attach autoscaler logs and the exact patch diff.

jamie_eng: starting the hotfix branch now. Will link PR here when ready.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem updates. Postmortem doc: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/6932109876-postmortem (draft).

ashley_oncall: Closing live paging. If anything regresses, re-open and page. Great job on the fast mitigation. :thumbsup:

end of thread.
